question: Dhamek Stupa is located in __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Varanasi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dhamek Stupa also spelled as Dhamekh and **Dhamekha are one of the famous Buddhist stupas in Sarnath near Varanasi in Uttar Pradesh,** India.
 
• Firstly erected in** 249 BCE during the reign of king Ashoka of the Maurya Dynasty**, this massive and prominent structure has gone through several expansions and additions over time.
 
• The significance of this sacred place is that it marks the spot where Lord Buddha sermonized the first sermon to His five votaries after attaining enlightenment in Bodh Gaya.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sravasti:**

 
 
• Various **Buddhist temples and monasteries** have been found at Sravasti, Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Sravasti was the capital of the Kosala empire in ancient India, and it was here that the Buddha spent most of his time after attaining enlightenment.
 
• Sravasti is regarded as one of **Buddhism's holiest sites**.
 
 
 
• **Kushinagar:**
 
 
• Kushinagar, a district in the state of Uttar Pradesh, India is **famous for the Buddhist pilgrimage.**
 
• It is considered to be one of the holiest places among the famous four pilgrimages of Buddhism.
 
• Lord Buddha gave his **last sermon** in Kushinagar. 
 
 
 
• **Gaya:**
 
 
• Bodh Gaya is a Buddhist pilgrimage site in the Gaya District of Bihar.
 
• Famous for the Mahabodhi Temple, It was here under the Bodhi tree that** Gautama Buddha attained enlightenment. **
